items.title: Research & Development
items.description: I turn research questions into experiments, algorithms, and working prototypes, drawing on experience across academic and industry-oriented projects.

items.title: Machine Learning & AI
items.description: I develop and evaluate machine learning models for prediction, classification, and anomaly detection, with applications in time-series data and biomedical analysis.

items.title: Data Science & Statistical Analysis
items.description: I bring together complex datasets, investigate patterns, and build reproducible analytical workflows that help answer practical and scientific questions.

items.title: IoT & Industry 4.0
items.description: I work with sensor data and distributed systems to understand equipment behaviour, detect faults, and support predictive maintenance.

items.title: Biomedical Analytics, Bioinformatics & Computational Neuroscience
items.description: I apply machine learning and statistical methods to biomedical questions, from medical imaging for Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis to genetic studies of disease. My interests extend to computational neuroscience and understanding the brain through data and models.
